meta.description: A form field with a label-on-top layout, used for plain text and value inputs.

verdict.title: Fix required before handoff
verdict.text: Trailing icon uses rectangle placeholder instead of swappable icon instance (C6). Code Connect mappings not yet registered (C7).

traits.name: Reusable
traits.note: Works across form contexts requiring labeled inputs with icons. Single-line only — no multi-line variant. Fixed 46px height with no size options.

traits.name: Self-contained
traits.note: Carries its own border, fill, icon slots, and text styles per state. All 4 interaction states defined. Disabled state has distinct background and hidden border.

traits.name: Consistent
traits.note: Boolean naming and casing fixed (C2 resolved): isFilled now uses true/false and property renamed to State. Action button layer renamed to action-button (C1 resolved).

traits.name: Composable
traits.note: Nests in form layouts. However, trailing-icon uses a rectangle placeholder instead of a swappable icon instance (C6), limiting icon customization at the consumer level.

resolved.body: isFilled renamed from Yes/No to true/false — now maps directly to Swift Bool / Kotlin Boolean C2 Fixed
Property state renamed to State (capitalized) — consistent with sibling Form Elements fields C2 Fixed
Button - XSmall layer renamed to action-button — now a semantic slot name for flexible consumer customization C1 Fixed
Trailing icon uses shared Placeholder component instance — swappable by design. Internal RECTANGLE is the default visual, replaced by designers when consuming the component C6 Closed

recommendations.headline: Replace hardcoded Button - XSmall with an action slot.
recommendations.body: Today the trailing action is baked in — consumers can't swap in other button variants or remove it. A named slot makes the action composable via instance swap.

recommendations.headline: Replace trailing-icon placeholder with a swappable icon instance.
recommendations.body: The current icon-placeholder RECTANGLE blocks designers from overriding the trailing icon without detaching. Follow the instance-swap pattern used elsewhere in the DS.

recommendations.headline: Add a helperText slot.
recommendations.body: Validation messages and hint copy are handled externally today — a first-class slot keeps the form anatomy self-contained.

usageGuidelines.doText: Use Labeled Field when the input needs a persistent label above the value, a leading icon for context, and an optional action button.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Use Labeled Field for simple text entry — use Input Field instead. Labeled Field is for complex form rows with icon context.

usageGuidelines.doText: Provide meaningful icons in the leading and trailing slots — they help users identify the field purpose at a glance.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Leave the icon placeholders as-is in production — always swap in a contextual icon or hide the slot.

scorecard.notes: Layer renamed to action-button, now a semantic slot name.
isFilled uses true/false. Property renamed to State (capitalized). Both fixes confirmed in Figma.
Colors appear correct but token binding not verified.
Maps to custom EBLabeledField on both platforms.
All 4 states defined: Default, Active, Error, Disabled.
trailing-icon uses icon-placeholder RECTANGLE — not a swappable icon instance.

rows.body: Action button layer renamed — Button - XSmall renamed to action-button. Now uses a semantic slot name, enabling flexible consumer customization and clean Code Connect mapping. Fixed
Boolean property renamed — isFilled values changed from Yes/No to true/false. Now maps directly to Swift Bool and Kotlin Boolean for Code Connect. Fixed
Property casing corrected — state renamed to State (capitalized) to align with sibling Form Elements fields (Input Field, etc.). Fixed

Component assessed — 8 variants documented across State (Default/Active/Error/Disabled) × isFilled (true/false). Part of Form Elements group. Enhanced input with leading icon, label/value text, action button, and trailing icon. Documented
Boolean property uses Yes/No — isFilled=Yes/No instead of true/false. Incompatible with Swift Bool and Kotlin Boolean for Code Connect mapping. Open
Lowercase property name — state uses lowercase, inconsistent with other Form Elements using State (capitalized). Open
Hardcoded button instance — Button - XSmall is not a named action slot, limiting consumer customization. Open
Trailing icon uses RECTANGLE — icon-placeholder in trailing-icon is a RECTANGLE, not a swappable icon instance. Open
Code Connect mappings — No CLI mappings registered yet. Blocked by C2 (property naming) and C6 (icon quality). Open
